niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces with strong clarity and structure: usually light or light-dominant backgrounds, clear section hierarchy, readable labeled actions, and organized card/row layouts. Tends to like calmer, more polished presentations with restrained accent use, softer rounded shapes, and explicit status or guidance cues. Often prefers spacious, simplified compositions with a single dominant focus, though in some dashboard contexts also responds positively to dense information when it is highly organized and clearly labeled.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light neutral or light-dominant interfaces, often with soft purple/pastel accents or a dark header only, over fully dark high-contrast screens.
Prefers strong hierarchy with clear section labels, readable grouping, prominent titles/summaries, and well-separated content blocks.
Prefers layouts that avoid clutter and visual competition, using either spacious simplified sections or compact dense rows only when organization remains very clear.
Prefers obvious labeled actions, clear CTA styling, visible form affordances, and explicit status/selection indicators rather than subtle, icon-only, or ambiguous controls.
Prefers organized card- or row-based compositions with symmetry, alignment, and a single dominant focal area instead of fragmented or weakly structured layouts.
Prefers softer rounded corners, gentle shadows/depth, friendly copy tone, and welcoming everyday visual treatment over harsh, sharp, or overly dramatic styling.
Prefers selective, subdued accent colors and a calm polished tone rather than flashy neon, overly promotional, or highly competitive color treatments.
